description:
Leinster Property are delighted to present Aylmer Lodge which is new to the market.  This impressive 4 bed detached AO zero-emission home featuring exceptionally high energy performance.  The property combines every possible modern convenience you would expect for your everyday needs, all presented in this superb property.  

Originally a 1940's cottage, the overall property now forms part of a complete new build, having been tastefully extended and transformed by the current owners, this property offers a luxurious finish inside and out and will appeal to a discerning owner seeking a place to call home. 

Duncreevan offers a peaceful rural location, yet less than 5 minutes drive Kilcock town, including some wonderful amenities nearby, such as the Royal Canal Greenway and Donadea Forest Park.  

Excellent selection of local public transport nearby with Kilcock Train station, the M4 motorway and regular bus service offering ease of connectivity to Dublin city, Airport and surrounding counties.  Maynooth University and town are a short distance away also.  Clongowes College and Naas Millennium Business Park are within easy reach.

The property is situated on circa 0.6 acres of landscaped gardens and is not overlooked over total privacy.  Some of the features include automatic entrance gates, detached garage of c.40sq.m.  Bespoke solid oak hand painted kitchen, and herring bone solid oak floors throughout the ground floor.  Solar panels fitted x 10 complete with 5kw battery, dual Samsung heat pump with digital stats in each room.  

With so much on offer this property really has that standout wow factor and needs to be viewed to be fully appreciated.

The accommodation in brief consists of  entrance hall with boot room area complimented with a handmade wardrobe space, Herring Bone solid oak floor fitted, leading to living room off, complete with solid Oak floor, wall mounted lights and two large picture windows offering views of the landscaped garden and mature trees.

The kitchen/family room is situated to the right of the entrance hall and doesn't fail to impress, it offers a large American style kitchen layout out with plenty of space for dining also.  The kitchen comes with a Bespoke handmade units complete with hand painted cabinet doors finished in Farrow and Ball Charleston grey.    The countertops are finished in Calacatta Gold stone.  Neff appliances are included also with a smart fridge, hob, oven and dishwasher.  

Velux windows above the breakfast bar offer wonderful additional natural light, fitted with rain sensors and combined with ceiling electric fan also, they combine to almost create a natural aircon system.  Double French doors off the kitchen open to the rear garden and patio with granite pavers nicely spaced around Donegal quartz stone chipping.

Additional ground floor accommodation offer two large double size bedrooms each with feature wall complete with built in wardrobes/storage.  The bedrooms come with solid Oak Herring Bone flooring and wonderful views of the garden.

The ground floor is complimented with a large downstairs bathroom complete with shower, whb with vanity mirror with integrated light and wc.  The bathroom comes with tiled floors and splash back.  Additional storage in the bathroom also with inset door offering understairs storage.

Upstairs provides a large bright landing with storage space off, fitted carpets also.

The two bedrooms are a good size doubles with master bedroom complete with walk in wardrobe and ensuite bathroom also.

The family bathroom comes complete with a full white suite, additional shower, vanity mirror with integrated light and under sink storage, wc, tiled floor and splash back also

Outside:

Large driveway with Donegal quartz stone chipping provides plenty of off-street parking.  The gardens extend to circa 0.6 acres with new lawn seeded.  The garden offers plenty of privacy and offers a blank canvas for avid gardens.

Detached garage of circa 40sq.m comes with electric roller shutter and plenty of storage for all your extras including garden equipment.
The property is nicely positioned off a quiet country road and full bordered with mature trees, shrubs and automatic gated for added security.
